overview: This single-page file consists of a confidential cross-reference sheet filed under the subject of public press and news-gathering agencies. It records that the substantive original was Telegram No. 5294, dated December 29, 1944, from Sweden, and directs researchers to State Department file 894.20258/12-2944; the telegram itself is not included.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to Telegram No. 5294 from Sweden
subfiles.about: The sheet directs the reader to the original December 29, 1944 telegram from Sweden filed under another decimal-file number.
subfiles.summary: This confidential cross-reference identifies Telegram No. 5294, dated December 29, 1944, as the original paper associated with the reference. It states that the telegram came from Sweden and directs the reader to file 894.20258/12-2944. No substantive text of the telegram appears on the sheet.

interest: The sheet is useful chiefly as a guide to the State Department’s wartime filing system and to the location of a related telegram that is absent from this bundle. Its placement under a press and news-agency subject heading may help historians reconstruct otherwise dispersed documentation concerning news dissemination and the geographic field of press operations in neutral Sweden during the Second World War.
